Bill.NotesEn: On December 13, 2022, the House of Commons ordered that Bill S-202, An Act to amend the Parliament of Canada Act (Parliamentary Visual Artist Laureate), standing in the name of the member for Bow River, shall now stand in the name of the member for Cloverdale—Langley City.
Bill.NotesFr: Le 13 décembre 2022, la Chambre a ordonnée que le projet de loi S-202, Loi modifiant la Loi sur le Parlement du Canada (artiste visuel officiel du Parlement), inscrit au Feuilleton au nom du député de Bow River, soit maintenant inscrit au nom du député de Cloverdale—Langley City.
Bill.Notes: On December 13, 2022, the House of Commons ordered that Bill S-202, An Act to amend the Parliament of Canada Act (Parliamentary Visual Artist Laureate), standing in the name of the member for Bow River, shall now stand in the name of the member for Cloverdale—Langley City.
